resistant_source.why_resistant: Source-central terms recur locally while the known operator vocabulary leaves the local unitization unresolved.

incompatible_unitizations.description: Treat recurrent source-native terms as a provisional local field before assigning a known ontology.
incompatible_unitizations.analytic_consequence: The analysis tests source co-presence before dependence, reciprocity or relation-first typing.

incompatible_unitizations.description: Treat the transition between adjacent source windows as the primary local event.
incompatible_unitizations.analytic_consequence: Different windows may require different routing instead of one corpus-wide profile.

incompatible_unitizations.description: Treat broken co-occurrences as provisional boundaries rather than missing data to be filled.
incompatible_unitizations.analytic_consequence: Absence becomes a testable routing constraint without becoming a metaphysical claim.

observed_failure.description: Known family routing translates the local source field into inherited relation categories before testing its own unitization.
observed_failure.lost_distinction: The difference between source-native co-presence and relation-profile classification disappears.

mutation.proposal: Add a reversible source-signature family that is activated by local source-native terms and compares rival unitizations.
mutation.cost: Adds one provisional family and increases local routing ambiguity until regression resolves it.
mutation.reversibility: Remove the added family by ID and restore the unchanged baseline registry.

new_operator.title: Open-set source field: silence / withdrawal
new_operator.diagnostic: What becomes visible before silence and withdrawal are translated into a known relation profile?
new_operator.constructive_move: Compare local term-field, transition and negative-boundary unitizations while preserving abstention.
new_operator.self_risk: The family can become an exception factory that rewards novelty without repeated source-linked gain.
new_operator.positive_model: Micro-local source-signature probe with explicit rollback and no presupposed ontology.

fixture.probe_text: The text returns to silence and withdrawal without resolving either into a fixed relation profile.

before_after_test.before_observation: No conditional family is source-born from the local silence/withdrawal signature.
before_after_test.after_observation: The new family activates on the same source span and opens rival local unitizations without changing the baseline registry.
before_after_test.discriminator: Retain only if the new family distinguishes at least one local window that known routing either collapses or leaves unresolved.

negative_tests.name: no automatic CORE promotion
negative_tests.note: ADD_OPERATOR yields an accepted candidate only.
